requirement.title: The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true
requirement.text:
#### Bug description

The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true. This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.

story: Stops the type collector from crashing on duplicate or mixed keys by skipping those members, and adds analyzer tests, execution tests and README docs for SuppressSourceGeneration types.

decisions.title: Dependency change in Directory.Packages.props
decisions.oneliner: Dependency and toolchain versions decide which users can build and run the package.
decisions.question: Accept this dependency or toolchain change?
decisions.routed_by: policy rule 'dependency': the reviewer may not decide this

decisions.title: Fix doesn't touch suppression handling
decisions.oneliner: Only the duplicate-key Add crash is fixed. Nothing in the diff changes how SuppressSourceGeneration types are routed through the analyzer.
decisions.requirement_part: The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true
decisions.would_be_wrong_if: The 3.1.1 regression was caused by the Dictionary.Add exception aborting analysis. If 3.1.1 instead skips suppressed types early, this diff does not fix the bug.
decisions.question: Did you confirm the 3.1.1 regression is the Dictionary.Add exception, for example by running MemberWithoutKeyIsReported against unpatched code?

decisions.title: Duplicate/mixed-key members silently dropped from model
decisions.oneliner: Members with a duplicate or mismatched key are skipped. Later checks on them (MsgPack003, formatter attribute) no longer run, and this also applies to generated types.
quote: continue; // The key kind does not match the other members; the diagnostic is reported, so skip this member.
decisions.would_be_wrong_if: MsgPack005 is error severity, so generation is blocked anyway and the extra checks don't matter.
decisions.question: Is it acceptable that a member with a bad key no longer gets its member-type diagnostics?

handled.title: Execution tests don't exercise the analyzer
handled.oneliner: The round-trip test only checks run-time dynamic serialization. That already worked, and the test says nothing about the analyzer bug.
handled.routed_by: low impact or no decision needed
